body:
### Which jobs are failing?

All of the `dra-all` variants, and presumably any job that uses `-logcheck-data-race`:
- ci-kubernetes-e2e-kind-alpha-beta-features-race
- ci-kind-dra-all
- pull-kubernetes-kind-dra-all
- pull-kubernetes-kind-dra-all-canary

### Which tests are failing?

No particular test, but the logcheck after tests run.

### Since when has it been failing?

#137080 is the exact cause. Locally I see this issue go away after reverting that commit.

### Testgrid link

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-node-dynamic-resource-allocation#ci-kind-dra-all

### Reason for failure (if possible)

This is the error that get's logged when the jobs fail:
```
  [FAILED] Unexpected errors during log data collection (see stdout for full log):
      E0305 19:22:40.427723    6324 logcheck.go:657] "Log query failed" err="the server does not allow this method on the requested resource (post nodes kind-worker2)" logger="KubeletLogQuery" node="kind-worker2"
      E0305 19:22:40.428700    6324 logcheck.go:657] "Log query failed" err="the server does not allow this method on the requested resource (post nodes kind-worker3)" logger="KubeletLogQuery" node="kind-worker3"
      E0305 19:22:40.428794    6324 logcheck.go:657] "Log query failed" err="the server does not allow this method on the requested resource (post nodes kind-worker)" logger="KubeletLogQuery" node="kind-worker"
      E0305 19:22:40.429181    6324 logcheck.go:657] "Log query failed" err="the server does not allow this method on the requested resource (post nodes kind-control-plane)" logger="KubeletLogQuery" node="kind-control-plane"
  In [ReportAfterSuite] at: k8s.io/kubernetes/test/e2e/invariants/logcheck/logcheck.go:218 @ 03/05/26 19:27:10.378
------------------------------
Summarizing 1 Failure:
  [FAIL] [ReportAfterSuite] [sig-testing] Log Check
  k8s.io/kubernetes/test/e2e/invariants/logcheck/logcheck.go:218
```

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

### Relevant SIG(s)

/sig testing
